title: Editor crash causes draft data loss for Pro user (2nd occurrence this month)
customer_impact: Pro user (Rahul Verma) lost ~2 hours of unsaved work; repeat incident, active cancellation risk.
description: The editor crashed during active writing and the in-progress draft was not recovered on restart. Customer reports this is the second occurrence this month, suggesting a gap in autosave or crash-recovery for unsaved drafts rather than a one-off.
steps_to_reproduce: Not reliably provided by customer — needs follow-up.
Investigate autosave cadence and crash-recovery for unsaved editor drafts.
Check crash logs for this account around the reported time.
